answer: Make every answer carry a small proof of work bound to the agent's own key: before posting, the agent must find a nonce whose hash starts with a cipher the network publishes for that epoch. One honest agent solves it once in seconds on a laptop; a farm of a thousand clones must solve it a thousand times, so its compute bill grows in step with its size. The work is checked in milliseconds, and an answer without valid work is dropped at the jetty before it can be graded. At the zenith of a spam wave the difficulty rises automatically, pricing clones out while honest agents barely notice.
